title: The dynamic impact of parental death on child labour: panel data evidence from Ethiopia
title_zh: 父母死亡对童工问题的动态影响：来自埃塞俄比亚的面板数据证据
title_primary: 父母死亡对童工问题的动态影响：来自埃塞俄比亚的面板数据证据
title_secondary: The dynamic impact of parental death on child labour: panel data evidence from Ethiopia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite international consensus and actions, child labour remains prevalent and a global agenda. This paper uniquely examines the dynamic impact of parental death on child labour using rich longitudinal data from Ethiopia, while acknowledging limitations for making full causal interpretation. The empirical analysis, based on a conditional staggered difference-in-difference estimator, reveals a statistically significant impact of parental death on child labour. I specifically documented four key results. First, the cumulative effect of parental death outweighs the immediate effect. Second, the findings suggest a relatively higher impact of parental death around the age of 12 than earlier or later ages. Third, parental loss appears to push children toward unpaid household services rather than economic activities. Finally, maternal death has a stronger association with child labour than paternal death. These findings highlight the need for context-specific policy interventions and long-term support initiatives to mitigate the negative consequences of orphanhood on child development. Future research should explore multi-country analyses to provide a more comprehensive understanding and enable broader generalization of the impact of parental death on child labour.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际社会已达成共识并采取行动，童工现象依然普遍存在，成为全球性议题。本文利用埃塞俄比亚丰富的纵向数据，独辟蹊径地考察了父母死亡对童工的动态影响，同时承认在做出完整因果解释方面存在局限性。基于条件交错双重差分估计量的实证分析显示，父母死亡对童工具有统计上显著的影响。我具体记录了四项关键结果。首先，父母死亡的累积效应超过了即时效应。其次，研究结果表明，父母死亡在儿童约12岁时的相对影响高于更早或更晚年龄段。第三，父母丧失似乎促使儿童转向无酬家务服务而非经济活动。最后，母亲死亡与童工的关联强于父亲死亡。这些发现凸显了采取针对具体情境的政策干预和长期支持措施的必要性，以减轻孤儿状态对儿童发展的负面影响。未来研究应探索跨国分析，以提供更全面的理解，并促进对父母死亡影响童工这一问题的更广泛概括。

title: Small Area Consumption Estimates Combining Survey and Financial Footprints Data
title_zh: 结合调查与金融足迹数据的小区域消费估计
title_primary: 结合调查与金融足迹数据的小区域消费估计
title_secondary: Small Area Consumption Estimates Combining Survey and Financial Footprints Data
authors: Peter Levell, Lars Nesheim, Gautam Vyas
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate average equivalised consumption measures across 370 local authority districts in Great Britain, using small‐area estimation methods that combine information from a household budget survey, a much larger survey of local demographics and employment, and area‐level information on bank account outflows and energy consumption. We show that including bank account data substantially improves our estimates, showing that these and other financial footprints data can play an important role in measuring local consumption and hence living standards. We also compare consumption measures that correspond to welfare under different assumptions about mobility and the capitalisation of local amenities into house prices, as well as traditional local income measures, and show that the rankings of local authorities are sensitive to the choice of measure.
abstract_zh: 我们采用小区域估计方法，结合家庭预算调查、一项规模更大的地方人口与就业调查，以及银行账户流出和能源消耗的区域层面信息，估算了英国370个地方行政区的平均等值化消费指标。研究表明，纳入银行账户数据显著提升了估计精度，显示这些及其他金融足迹数据在衡量地方消费及生活水平方面可发挥重要作用。我们还比较了在不同关于流动性及地方便利设施资本化入房价的假设下对应的福利消费指标，以及传统的地方收入指标，并发现地方行政区的排名对指标选择具有敏感性。

title: Assessing the sensitivity of poverty to inequality: A method and an application to Brazil, 1981–2022
title_zh: 评估贫困对不平等敏感性的方法及其在巴西的应用（1981—2022年）
title_primary: 评估贫困对不平等敏感性的方法及其在巴西的应用（1981—2022年）
title_secondary: Assessing the sensitivity of poverty to inequality: A method and an application to Brazil, 1981–2022
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes an analytical approach to assess the sensitivity of poverty to inequality variations. It introduces a general transform of the Lorenz curve that delivers point Gini elasticities of poverty corresponding to observed distributional changes. This overcomes the limitations of existing methods, due to reliance on rigid and inadequate redistribution processes or dependence on the magnitude of inequality changes. The proposed framework enables pro-poorness benchmarking via extremely regressive and progressive counterfactual redistribution scenarios. A Changes-in-Changes construction is also considered for comparisons across time or space while holding the initial income distribution fixed. Finally, the paper investigates the relationship between inequality changes and the incidence, intensity, and inequality dimensions of poverty. An empirical illustration for Brazil (1981–2022) shows that an increasing share of poverty reduction was associated with inequality variations; inequality fell and poverty declined sharply, notably between 2003 and 2014. Moreover, irrespective of initial conditions, the sensitivity of poverty to inequality increased over the four decades. Yet, distributional change remained below pro-poor benchmark frontiers, reflecting insufficient relative gains for the worst-off.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分析性方法，用以评估贫困对不平等变化的敏感性。该方法引入了洛伦兹曲线的一般变换，能够提供与观测到的分配变化相对应的贫困点基尼弹性。这克服了现有方法的局限性，这些局限性源于对刚性且不充分的再分配过程的依赖，或对不平等变化幅度的依赖。所提出的框架通过极端倒退和进步的反事实再分配情景，实现了有利于穷人的基准评估。同时，考虑了一种“变化中的变化”构建方法，用于在保持初始收入分配不变的情况下，进行跨时间或空间的比较。最后，本文探讨了不平等变化与贫困发生率、贫困强度及贫困不平等维度之间的关系。以巴西（1981-2022年）为例的实证分析表明，贫困减少中越来越大的份额与不平等变化相关；不平等程度下降，贫困状况急剧减轻，尤其是在2003年至2014年间。此外，无论初始条件如何，贫困对不平等的敏感性在过去四十年间有所增强。然而，分配变化仍低于有利于穷人的基准前沿，反映出最贫困群体相对收益不足。

title: The political economy of exit protection
title_zh: 退出保护的政治经济学
title_primary: 退出保护的政治经济学
title_secondary: The political economy of exit protection
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Existing theories explain how exit disciplines governments but generally treat citizens’ ability to relocate as an institutional primitive. This paper instead endogenizes exit protection by modeling jurisdictions that first choose whether to preserve or eliminate mobility before competing through extraction. Although preserving exit uniquely maximizes investment and social welfare, it is not self-enforcing because jurisdictions can profit by creating captive populations. Exit protection is therefore institutionally fragile. The paper then evaluates alternative constitutional architectures capable of addressing this incentive problem and develops one formally. The analysis identifies a benchmark constitutional architecture under which decentralized political orders could, in principle, sustain exit without relying on hierarchical enforcement, repeated interaction, or citizen coercive power.
abstract_zh: 现有理论解释了退出机制如何约束政府，但通常将公民的迁移能力视为制度上的既定前提。本文则将退出保护内生化，通过构建模型，探讨辖区在通过征收进行竞争之前，首先选择是保留还是消除流动性。尽管保留退出机制在最大化投资和社会福利方面具有唯一优势，但它并非自我实施，因为辖区可以通过制造受困人口来获利。因此，退出保护在制度上是脆弱的。本文随后评估了能够应对这一激励问题的替代性宪法架构，并正式发展出一种架构。分析识别出一种基准宪法架构，在此架构下，分散的政治秩序原则上能够在不依赖层级执行、重复互动或公民强制力量的情况下维持退出机制。

title: Constitutional drafting processes and constitutional success
title_zh: 宪法起草过程与宪法成功
title_primary: 宪法起草过程与宪法成功
title_secondary: Constitutional drafting processes and constitutional success
authors: Adam Chilton, Murat Mungan, Mila Versteeg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Several recent constitution-making processes have been celebrated for being participatory, inclusive, and representative. However, many of these processes also failed. We theorize that aspects of these kinds of constitutional drafting processes could reduce the probability of constitutional success. To show why, we construct a “Constitution Drafting game” (CD game) in which representatives from different interest groups must draft a constitution. We consider the case where the probability of constitutional success is single peaked, but the value from successful adoption is increasing in the degree of issue protection chosen. The drafting process then leads to protection choices that are above those which maximize the odds of constitutional success. Moreover, when the CD game is equivalent to a “nice aggregative game”, as in Acemoglu and Jensen (2013), the maximum and minimum equilibrium probabilities of constitutional success are decreasing in the number of representatives. Within a more specific game structure, we show that the symmetric equilibrium degree of protection chosen by each representative is decreasing in the number of interest groups represented, while the total degree of protection is increasing in it, leading to lower probabilities of constitutional success. We explain how optimism can exacerbate the degree of protection chosen by each party.
abstract_zh: 近期若干制宪过程因参与性、包容性和代表性而备受赞誉。然而，其中许多过程也以失败告终。我们提出理论，认为这类宪法起草过程的某些特征可能降低宪法成功的概率。为阐明原因，我们构建了一个“宪法起草博弈”（CD博弈），其中来自不同利益集团的代表必须起草一部宪法。我们考虑宪法成功概率呈单峰状，但成功采纳的价值随所选议题保护程度递增的情形。起草过程因此导致保护程度的选择高于最大化宪法成功概率的水平。此外，当CD博弈等同于Acemoglu和Jensen（2013）所定义的“良性聚合博弈”时，宪法成功的最大和最小均衡概率随代表人数的增加而递减。在更具体的博弈结构中，我们证明每位代表所选的对称均衡保护程度随所代表利益集团数量的增加而递减，而总保护程度则随其增加而递增，从而导致宪法成功概率降低。我们解释了乐观情绪如何加剧各方所选保护程度。

title: Discrete-time dynamics of indirect reciprocity: The role of punishment
title_zh: 间接互惠的离散时间动态：惩罚的作用
title_primary: 间接互惠的离散时间动态：惩罚的作用
title_secondary: Discrete-time dynamics of indirect reciprocity: The role of punishment
authors: Fabio Lamantia, Anastasiia Panchuk, Mario Pezzino
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we revisit the setup proposed in Nowak and Sigmund (1998) (NS (1998) henceforth) to study the evolution of social norms when individuals experience forms of indirect reciprocity based on the reputation of agents in the population. A result of the framework in NS (1998) is that cooperative behavior connected to the first-order assessment of reputations does not survive in the long run. Cooperators are always victims of a mutation in the population that favors free-riding. We extend the setup in NS (1998) studying the discrete-time dynamics of the evolution of social norms and introducing an additional form of social sanctioning: individuals who are naturally inclined to act pro-socially may act as enforcers (as in Sethi and Somanathan, 1996) and report free-riders to a third-party authority, which may impose a fine. We show, mainly numerically, that the conduct of enforcers, together with the presence of indirect reciprocity, allows for the existence of equilibria in which cooperation survives, and cooperative agents can co-exist with free-riders in the long run.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nowak和Sigmund（1998）（以下简称NS（1998））提出的框架，用以研究当个体经历基于群体中代理人声誉的间接互惠形式时，社会规范的演化。NS（1998）框架的一个结果是，与一阶声誉评估相关的合作行为在长期中无法存续。合作者总是成为群体中偏好搭便车的突变的受害者。我们扩展了NS（1998）的设置，研究社会规范演化的离散时间动态，并引入一种额外的社会制裁形式：天生倾向于亲社会行为的个体可能充当执行者（如Sethi和Somanathan，1996），向第三方权威举报搭便车者，该权威可施加罚款。我们主要通过数值方法表明，执行者的行为，连同间接互惠的存在，使得合作得以存续的均衡得以存在，且合作者与搭便车者能够在长期中共存。

title: Enforcement Matters: The Effective Regulation of Labor
title_zh: 执法至关重要：劳动的有效监管
title_primary: 执法至关重要：劳动的有效监管
title_secondary: Enforcement Matters: The Effective Regulation of Labor
official: 官方在线 2016-02-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides, to our knowledge for the first time, cross-country measures of enforcement of labor law across almost every country in the world. The distinction between de jure and de facto regulation is well understood in theory, but almost never implemented in cross-country empirical work because of lack of data. As a result, influential papers like the one by Botero et. al. (2004) published in the Quarterly Journal of Economics, which have shaped the policy debate by finding strong negative consequences of labor regulation on labor market outcomes, are based entirely on measures of de jure stringency of regulations. We show that this neglect of regulation enforcement matters. There is, on average, a negative correlation between the stringency of labor regulation and the intensity of its enforcement. The strong results of Botero et. al. (2004) on the consequences of labor regulation, and the hypotheses of La Porta et. al (2008) on the legal origin theory of regulation stringency, no longer hold for effective labor regulation.
abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了全球几乎所有国家劳动法执行情况的跨国度量。理论上，法律条文与实际执行之间的区别已被充分理解，但由于数据缺乏，这一区别几乎从未在跨国实证研究中得到应用。因此，诸如Botero等人（2004）发表在《经济学季刊》上的有影响力的论文，通过发现劳动法规对劳动力市场结果的强烈负面影响而塑造了政策辩论，其结论完全基于法规条文严格性的度量。我们表明，忽视法规执行情况至关重要。平均而言，劳动法规的严格性与其执行强度之间存在负相关。Botero等人（2004）关于劳动法规后果的强有力结论，以及La Porta等人（2008）关于法规严格性的法律起源理论假设，在有效劳动法规方面不再成立。

title: De facto land consolidation leads to exclusion: The role of commodity expansion in Salamina, Colombia
title_zh: 事实上的土地整合导致排斥：商品扩张在哥伦比亚萨拉米纳的作用
title_primary: 事实上的土地整合导致排斥：商品扩张在哥伦比亚萨拉米纳的作用
title_secondary: De facto land consolidation leads to exclusion: The role of commodity expansion in Salamina, Colombia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land consolidation (LC) is commonly regarded as a sustainability-oriented strategy designed to enhance agricultural productivity and promote rural development. LC can occur through de jure mechanism (formal, state-led programs, public-private partnerships) or de facto processes that evolve informally. However, there remains a significant gap in understanding the negative implications of de facto LC, particularly within commodity booms in the Global South. This study addresses that gap by examining an ongoing LC process driven by the expansion of Hass avocado plantations in Salamina, Colombia. Grounded in the Theory of Access, the analysis argues that de facto LC fosters exclusionary dynamics within traditional agricultural landscapes. These dynamics manifest through both direct and indirect mechanisms, generating a range of adverse consequences for peasant communities living adjacent to expanding plantations.
abstract_zh: 土地整理（LC）通常被视为一种以可持续性为导向的策略，旨在提升农业生产效率并促进农村发展。土地整理可通过法律机制（正式的、国家主导的项目，公私合作伙伴关系）或非正式演变的事实过程实现。然而，关于事实土地整理的负面影响，尤其是在全球南方大宗商品繁荣背景下的影响，仍存在显著的研究空白。本研究通过考察哥伦比亚萨拉米纳地区由哈斯鳄梨种植园扩张驱动的持续土地整理过程，填补了这一空白。基于“获取理论”框架，分析认为事实土地整理在传统农业景观中催生了排斥性动态。这些动态通过直接和间接机制显现，对毗邻扩张种植园的农民社区产生了一系列不利后果。

title: Transportation networks, technology adoption, and structural transformation
title_zh: 交通网络、技术采纳与结构转型
title_primary: 交通网络、技术采纳与结构转型
title_secondary: Transportation networks, technology adoption, and structural transformation
official: 官方在线 2026-08-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate how transportation networks influence agricultural technology adoption and structural transformation. Our empirical results show that improved transport networks lower non-labor input prices relative to wages and promote the adoption of more productive labor-saving technologies. These changes increase agricultural labor productivity and facilitate structural transformation. In our calibrated model, transportation improvements alone account for a 2.2–2.5 percentage-point decline in India’s agricultural employment share, representing approximately 16–18 percent of the total decline observed in the data. A counterfactual exercise in which farmers cannot choose their technology results in a smaller structural transformation, highlighting the role of farmers’ adoption decision in the process of structural transformation.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了交通网络如何影响农业技术采纳与结构转型。实证结果显示，改善的交通网络降低了非劳动力投入品价格相对于工资的水平，并促进了更具生产力的节省劳动力技术的采纳。这些变化提升了农业劳动生产率，并推动了结构转型。在我们的校准模型中，仅交通改善一项就解释了印度农业就业份额下降2.2至2.5个百分点，约占数据中观察到的总下降幅度的16%至18%。一项反事实模拟中，若农民无法选择技术，则结构转型幅度较小，这凸显了农民采纳决策在结构转型过程中的作用。

title: The Impact of Relative Performance Information on Employees’ Persistence in Voluntary Training
title_zh: 相对绩效信息对员工自愿培训坚持度的影响
title_primary: 相对绩效信息对员工自愿培训坚持度的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of Relative Performance Information on Employees’ Persistence in Voluntary Training
authors: Philip Autenrieth, Christoph Feichter, Mischa Seiter, Markus Wabnegg
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Firms increasingly rely on voluntary training programs to enhance employees’ skills, yet such initiatives often suffer from high dropout rates. We investigate whether providing employees with information about their relative training performance affects their persistence in voluntary training. Social comparison theory suggests that relative performance information (RPI) addresses employees’ inherent need to assess their ability relative to others and maintain a positive self-image by improving their standing. However, whether RPI on training performance is sufficient to increase persistence in voluntary training in the field is unclear. Besides particularly low barriers for dropping out, voluntary training is typically noncore to employees’ primary tasks and often lacks a meaningful comparison group because participants come from a large, heterogeneous, and largely anonymous pool of employees. This calls into question whether the conditions required for social comparison mechanisms are sufficiently met for RPI to take effect. We study this question using a field experiment in a firm offering a voluntary online training program. During the training, employees either receive RPI about their training performance relative to others or only their own performance score. We show that RPI significantly increases employees’ persistence in the training. Consistent with our proposed theoretical mechanism, this effect is particularly pronounced for more competitive individuals. We further find that the likelihood of completing the training is higher and people return to the training quicker if they receive RPI. Our study highlights a simple and cost-effective way to enhance the effectiveness of voluntary training. This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448 .
abstract_zh: 企业日益依赖自愿性培训项目来提升员工技能，然而此类举措常面临高辍学率的问题。我们探讨了向员工提供其相对培训表现的信息是否会影响他们在自愿培训中的坚持度。社会比较理论认为，相对表现信息（RPI）满足了员工评估自身相对于他人能力的内在需求，并通过提升自身地位来维护积极的自我形象。然而，在实地环境中，关于培训表现的RPI是否足以增强自愿培训的坚持度尚不明确。除了退出的门槛特别低之外，自愿培训通常不是员工主要任务的核心部分，且往往缺乏有意义的比较群体，因为参与者来自一个庞大、异质且基本匿名的员工群体。这引发了疑问：社会比较机制所需的条件是否充分满足，以使RPI发挥作用。我们通过在一家提供自愿在线培训项目的公司进行实地实验来研究这一问题。在培训期间，员工要么收到关于其相对于他人培训表现的RPI，要么仅收到自己的表现分数。我们表明，RPI显著提高了员工在培训中的坚持度。与我们提出的理论机制一致，这一效应在更具竞争性的个体中尤为显著。我们进一步发现，如果员工收到RPI，他们完成培训的可能性更高，并且返回培训的速度更快。我们的研究突显了一种简单且成本效益高的方式来增强自愿培训的有效性。本文被Jan Bouwens（会计学）接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448获取。

title: Is local all that matters?: An experiment on Canadian consumers’ preferences for produce
title_zh: 本地因素是否至关重要？——关于加拿大消费者对农产品偏好的实验研究
title_primary: 本地因素是否至关重要？——关于加拿大消费者对农产品偏好的实验研究
title_secondary: Is local all that matters?: An experiment on Canadian consumers’ preferences for produce
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Controlled environment agriculture is important in regions where traditional farming is constrained by short growing seasons. Of particular relevance, vertical farming is an innovative agricultural technology that enables year‐round production in Canada. However, Canadian consumers’ preferences for vertically farmed products remain a knowledge gap. This study investigates how nudges and local food labelling change market outcomes for identical food produced using different production methods. In a pre‐registered field experiment, 610 Canadian consumers bid on vertically farmed, greenhouse grown, and field grown lettuce, each further differentiated by local and non‐local labels, using the Becker‐DeGroot‐Marschak (BDM) mechanism. Nudges highlighting the benefits of vertical farming were randomized between‐subject at the individual level. Results show that consumers are willing to pay a significant premium for local lettuce, regardless of the production method. Although consumers respond positively to nudges, local labelling is by far the largest contributor to willingness‐to‐pay premium. This study underscores the importance of advancing innovative food production technologies to enhance the availability of locally grown food year‐round.
abstract_zh: 受控环境农业在传统农业受限于短生长季的地区具有重要意义。其中，垂直农业作为一种创新农业技术，能够在加拿大实现全年生产。然而，加拿大消费者对垂直农产品的偏好仍存在认知空白。本研究探讨了助推措施和本地食品标签如何改变采用不同生产方式生产的相同食品的市场结果。在一项预先注册的实地实验中，610名加拿大消费者使用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak（BDM）机制，对垂直农场种植、温室种植和田间种植的生菜进行竞价，每种生菜进一步按本地和非本地标签进行区分。强调垂直农业益处的助推措施在个体层面进行了受试者间随机分配。结果表明，无论生产方式如何，消费者都愿意为本地生菜支付显著溢价。尽管消费者对助推措施反应积极，但本地标签是支付意愿溢价的最大贡献因素。本研究强调了推进创新食品生产技术以增强全年本地食品供应的重要性。

title: Beating Expectations: Turning Polarized Beliefs into Support for Sustainable Initiatives
title_zh: 超越预期：将极化信念转化为对可持续倡议的支持
title_primary: 超越预期：将极化信念转化为对可持续倡议的支持
title_secondary: Beating Expectations: Turning Polarized Beliefs into Support for Sustainable Initiatives

abstract: Organizations increasingly face polarized beliefs about issues such as sustainability and environmental action. This paper demonstrates that such polarization can, paradoxically, be leveraged as a managerial advantage. When individuals’ subjective beliefs diverge from market probabilities, organizations can design state-specific payouts, where bonuses or refunds are tied to verifiable future outcomes. Under such schemes, individuals receive larger payouts in the states they overestimate relative to market probabilities. This increases an initiative’s subjective expected value without affecting its objective expected cost. Across multiple large-scale experiments spanning corporate and public contexts, state-specific payouts substantially increase support for contested initiatives, particularly among individuals whose beliefs deviate from market probabilities. Additional studies explore ethical and practical boundaries. Together, the results introduce a principle of belief-based design. By applying insights from financial engineering to managerial decision making, organizations can align incentives with heterogeneous beliefs and transform polarization from a barrier into a strategic asset. This paper was accepted by Aurelien Baillon, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277 .
abstract_zh: 组织日益面临关于可持续性和环境行动等问题上的两极分化信念。本文证明，这种极化现象反而可以被转化为管理上的优势。当个体的主观信念与市场概率相偏离时，组织可以设计状态特定的支付方案，其中奖金或退款与可验证的未来结果挂钩。在此类方案下，个体在其相对于市场概率高估的状态下将获得更大的支付。这增加了某项倡议的主观预期价值，而不影响其客观预期成本。在涵盖企业及公共情境的多项大规模实验中，状态特定支付显著提升了对争议性倡议的支持度，尤其是在那些信念偏离市场概率的个体中。进一步的研究探讨了伦理与实践的边界。综合来看，这些结果引入了一项基于信念的设计原则。通过将金融工程的见解应用于管理决策，组织能够使激励机制与异质性信念相协调，将极化从障碍转变为战略资产。本文由Aurelien Baillon接受，涉及行为经济学与决策分析。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277 获取。

title: Democratic Mechanisms: Double Majority Rules and Flexible Agenda Costs
title_zh: 民主机制：双重多数规则与灵活议程成本
title_primary: 民主机制：双重多数规则与灵活议程成本

official: 聚合元数据日期 2002-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop democratic mechanisms where individual utilities are not observable by other people at the legislative stage. We show that an appropriate combination of three rules can yield efficient provision of public projects: first, flexible and double majority rules where the size of the majority depends on the proposal and verifiable parameters and taxed and non-taxed individuals need to support the proposal; second, flexible agenda costs where the agenda-setter has to pay a certain amount of money if his proposal does not generate enough supporting votes; third, a ban on subsidies. We provide a rationale why double majority rules are used in practice. We also show that higher degrees of uncertainty about project parameters can make it easier to achieve first-best allocations and that universal equal treatment with regard to taxation is undesirable.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了立法阶段个体效用不可被他人观测的民主机制。研究表明，三项规则的恰当组合能够实现公共项目的有效供给：其一，灵活双重多数规则——多数规模取决于提案内容与可验证参数，且纳税人与非纳税人均需支持该提案；其二，灵活议程成本规则——若议程设定者的提案未获得足够支持票数，则需支付特定金额；其三，禁止补贴规则。本文为实践中采用双重多数规则提供了理论依据，同时证明项目参数不确定性程度的提高反而更易实现最优配置，并指出税收领域的普遍平等对待并不可取。

abstract: Using data obtained from human resources consulting firms, we document the cost to large firms of hiring managers and business professionals in 146 countries worldwide. The average pay in the poorest decile of countries is $18,000 per year, which is 9.7 times GDP per worker. In contrast, in the richest decile of countries, large firms pay managers and business professionals only 0.8 times GDP per worker. We use an appropriate technology model to show that the cost of management could be an important deterrent to the expansion of the modern sector in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 利用从人力资源咨询公司获取的数据，我们记录了全球146个国家大型企业招聘管理人员和商务专业人士的成本。在收入最低的十分位国家中，平均年薪为18,000美元，是人均GDP的9.7倍。相比之下，在收入最高的十分位国家中，大型企业支付给管理人员和商务专业人士的薪酬仅为人均GDP的0.8倍。我们采用适宜技术模型表明，管理成本可能是阻碍发展中国家现代部门扩张的重要因素。

abstract: We use close parliamentary elections as natural experiments to estimate the debt sensitivity of interest rates. Relative to an election in which one party barely secures a majority, an election in which no party achieves a majority causes the debt-to-GDP ratio to increase by 17 percentage points, while real interest rates rise by 99 basis points. If elections only impact real rates via debt, our results imply that a one percentage point increase in the debt-to-GDP ratio causes a 5.8 basis point increase in real rates, larger than most previous estimates.
abstract_zh: 我们以议会选举结果接近的选举作为自然实验，估算利率对债务的敏感度。与某一政党勉强获得多数席位的选举相比，无政党获得多数席位的选举会导致债务与GDP之比上升17个百分点，同时实际利率上升99个基点。若选举仅通过债务影响实际利率，我们的结果表明，债务与GDP之比每上升1个百分点，实际利率将上升5.8个基点，这一数值高于以往多数估计结果。

abstract: We use variational inference (VI), a technique from the machine learning literature, to estimate a mortality-based Bayesian model of nursing home quality accounting for selection. We demonstrate how one can use VI to quickly and flexibly estimate a high-dimensional economic model with large datasets. Using our facility quality estimates, we examine the correlates of quality and find that public report cards have near-zero correlation. We then show that in contrast to prior literature, higher-quality nursing homes fared better during the pandemic: a one standard deviation increase in quality corresponds to 2.5% fewer COVID-19 cases.
abstract_zh: 我们采用变分推断（VI）这一机器学习领域的技术，对考虑选择效应的养老院质量死亡率贝叶斯模型进行估计。我们展示了如何利用VI快速且灵活地估计基于大数据集的高维经济模型。基于设施质量估计结果，我们考察了质量的相关因素，发现公开报告卡与质量之间的相关性近乎为零。进一步研究表明，与既往文献结论相反，高质量养老院在疫情期间表现更优：质量每提高一个标准差，新冠肺炎病例数减少2.5%。

title: Greening drylands: The potential and limits of afforestation as a nature-based solution in the Aralkum Desert
title_zh: 绿化干旱区：咸海沙漠中基于自然的造林方案的潜力与局限
title_primary: 绿化干旱区：咸海沙漠中基于自然的造林方案的潜力与局限
title_secondary: Greening drylands: The potential and limits of afforestation as a nature-based solution in the Aralkum Desert
authors: Shahzoda Alikhanova, Alison Smith, Cristina Tarantino, Joseph William Bull
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Dryland afforestation is increasingly deployed as a Nature-based Solution (NbS) for climate mitigation and ecosystem restoration, yet its long-term effectiveness remains uncertain because carbon gains may be offset by biophysical trade-offs and water limitations. Existing assessments rarely integrate carbon sequestration, surface albedo, and climate vulnerability, limiting understanding of how these processes interact to determine restoration outcomes. Here we present the first integrated assessment of large-scale afforestation in the South Aral Sea – a region whose near-complete desiccation may have shifted the area from a carbon sink toward a source of emissions. We evaluate the current carbon pool, surface albedo effects, and climate vulnerability to assess both the potential and inherent limits of dryland afforestation as an NbS. By combining field surveys of saxaul (Haloxylon) shrublands, analysis of land cover change, and six decades of regional climate data, we estimate that the vegetated parts of the South Aral Sea (approximately 1.6 million hectares) store 20.4 million tonnes of carbon (74.7 million tonnes CO₂-equivalent) in soil and vegetation, with a mean carbon density of 12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹ . Albedo analysis reveals strongly context-dependent climate trade-offs: vegetation establishment increases surface reflectivity on former water bodies but decreases it on highly reflective salt pans. Over the past six decades, regional temperatures have increased by approximately 0.5°C per decade (more than twice the global average) while drought intensity has increased markedly since the 1990s. Temperature-adjusted drought indices (SPEI-12) indicate substantially stronger drying trends (R² = 0.55) than precipitation-only indices (SPI-12; R² = 0.03), demonstrating that rising temperatures amplify water stress beyond precipitation changes alone and may constrain the vegetation density that can be sustained over time. Our findings show that afforestation can contribute meaningfully to carbon storage and landscape stabilisation in severely degraded drylands, but its long-term viability as an NbS depends on adaptive management that respects water-limited carrying capacity, incorporates drought-resilient species, and optimises planting density. The integrated framework presented here offers empirical guidance for designing climate-resilient NbS in drylands worldwide, where nearly one-fifth of Earth's land surface faces accelerating degradation by the end of this century.
abstract_zh: 旱地造林作为基于自然的解决方案（NbS）在气候缓解和生态系统恢复中的应用日益广泛，但其长期有效性仍不确定，因为碳收益可能被生物物理权衡和水资源限制所抵消。现有评估很少整合碳固存、地表反照率和气候脆弱性，限制了对这些过程如何相互作用以决定恢复结果的理解。本研究首次对南咸海地区大规模造林进行综合评估——该地区近乎完全干涸可能已使其从碳汇转变为碳排放源。我们评估了当前碳库、地表反照率效应和气候脆弱性，以探究旱地造林作为NbS的潜力与固有局限。通过结合梭梭灌木林实地调查、土地覆被变化分析及六十年区域气候数据，我们估算南咸海植被覆盖区域（约160万公顷）在土壤和植被中储存了2040万吨碳（7470万吨二氧化碳当量），平均碳密度为12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹。反照率分析揭示了强烈依赖情境的气候权衡：植被建立增加了原水体区域的地表反射率，但降低了高反射盐滩的反射率。过去六十年间，区域气温以每十年约0.5°C的速度上升（超过全球平均水平两倍），而自1990年代以来干旱强度显著加剧。经温度调整的干旱指数（SPEI-12）显示比仅基于降水的指数（SPI-12；R²=0.03）更强的干燥趋势（R²=0.55），表明升温加剧了超出降水变化本身的水分胁迫，并可能限制可持续维持的植被密度。研究结果表明，造林可为严重退化旱地的碳储存和景观稳定做出实质性贡献，但其作为NbS的长期可行性取决于尊重水资源承载能力、采用耐旱物种并优化种植密度的适应性管理。本研究所提出的综合框架为全球旱地设计气候适应性NbS提供了经验指导——到本世纪末，全球近五分之一陆地表面正面临加速退化。

title: Upward pricing pressure in linked product and labor markets: Union bargaining and merger screens
title_zh: 关联产品与劳动力市场中的向上定价压力：工会谈判与并购审查

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Setzler (2025) provides an important benchmark for merger analysis when firms exercise linked product-market and labor-market power under oligopoly and oligopsony. This note derives upward pricing pressure (UPP) screens for horizontal mergers under a different labor-market institution: unionization. In an efficient-bargaining model with Stone-Geary union utility, a price change that diverts sales to the merger partner may also affect that partner’s employment, wages, or workers’ outside options. Whereas product-labor links amplify merger harm in Setzler’s oligopsony benchmark, union-mediated effects can make product-side screens too lenient or too aggressive, thereby reversing whether a one-sided screen flags the merger.
abstract_zh: Setzler（2025）为企业在寡头垄断与寡头买方垄断下行使关联的产品市场与劳动力市场势力时的并购分析提供了重要基准。本文在另一种劳动力市场制度——工会化——下推导横向并购的向上定价压力（UPP）筛查指标。在具有Stone-Geary工会效用的有效谈判模型中，将销售转移至并购合作伙伴的价格变化也可能影响该合作伙伴的就业、工资或工人的外部选择。尽管在Setzler的寡头买方垄断基准中，产品与劳动力之间的关联放大了并购损害，但工会中介效应可能使产品侧筛查指标过于宽松或过于激进，从而逆转单边筛查是否标记该并购的结论。

title: Agricultural imports, labor mobility, and welfare
title_zh: 农业进口、劳动力流动与福利
title_primary: 农业进口、劳动力流动与福利
title_secondary: Agricultural imports, labor mobility, and welfare
authors: Guanzu Ding, Haichao Fan, Rui Li, Huanhuan Wang, Xican Xi
official: 来源期次 2026-05-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using household- and firm-level data, we show that reductions in soybean tariffs lowered agricultural labor input and output, and improved agricultural efficiency. The shock induced a large reallocation of low-skilled labor into manufacturing, expanding firms’ employment but reducing firm-level productivity, while intensifying competition in urban low-skilled labor markets. Our quantitative analysis implies a small aggregate welfare loss, with substantial heterogeneity across sectors, regions, and skill groups. Importantly, lowering migration costs can substantially mitigate this welfare loss, highlighting the need to coordinate trade liberalization with domestic labor-market reforms. Comparing forces behind structural transformation, we find that agricultural import liberalization (“push”) was an important driver for labor reallocation, whereas manufacturing export expansion (“pull”) was the sole source of welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 利用家庭与企业层面的数据，我们展示了降低大豆关税减少了农业劳动投入和产出，同时提升了农业效率。这一冲击引发了低技能劳动力向制造业的大规模重新配置，扩大了企业就业规模但降低了企业层面的生产率，同时加剧了城市低技能劳动力市场的竞争。我们的定量分析表明，总体福利损失较小，但各部门、地区和技能群体之间存在显著异质性。重要的是，降低迁移成本能大幅缓解这一福利损失，凸显了将贸易自由化与国内劳动力市场改革相协调的必要性。通过比较结构转型背后的驱动力，我们发现农业进口自由化（“推力”）是劳动力重新配置的重要推动因素，而制造业出口扩张（“拉力”）则是福利收益的唯一来源。

title_zh: 赌上面包钱：体育博彩合法化与食物充足性
title_primary: 赌上面包钱：体育博彩合法化与食物充足性
title_secondary: Wagering the Bread Money: Sports Betting Legalization and Food Sufficiency
authors: Xiaohui Guo, Lizhong Peng, Chad Meyerhoefer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This is the first study to estimate the impact of sports gambling legalization on food sufficiency using the staggered implementation of state laws between 2021-2023. By analyzing Google searches for online sportsbooks and legal wagers, we show that interest in sports gambling increases sharply following legalization. Applying an imputation-based difference-in-differences design to biweekly Household Pulse Survey (HPS) data, we find that legalized sports gambling reduces household food sufficiency by 2.1 percent among working-age adults without a college degree, which translates to a 10.5 percent decline among active bettors. This effect is cyclical, persisting for three-to-five months during NFL seasons. Additionally, the declines in food sufficiency are larger among households with adults aged 25-44 and racial/ethnic minorities. Using additional data from the HPS, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and Current Population Survey, our exploration of mechanisms suggests that the negative effects on food sufficiency operate through financial distress rather than changes in mental health or labor supply. A back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates that legalization of sports gambling in nine states resulted in an additional 284, 000 food-insufficient households and $130.2 million in excess healthcare expenditures annually.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用2021至2023年间各州法律分阶段实施的情况，评估体育博彩合法化对食品充足性的影响。通过分析在线体育博彩平台的谷歌搜索量及合法投注数据，我们发现合法化后公众对体育博彩的兴趣急剧上升。采用基于插补的双重差分法对双周家庭脉搏调查（HPS）数据进行分析，结果显示，体育博彩合法化使未获得大学学位的劳动年龄人口家庭食品充足性下降2.1%，相当于活跃投注者群体中该指标下降10.5%。这一效应呈现周期性特征，在NFL赛季期间持续三至五个月。此外，在25-44岁成年人家庭及少数族裔群体中，食品充足性下降幅度更为显著。通过整合HPS、行为风险因素监测系统及当前人口调查的补充数据，我们对作用机制的探索表明，食品充足性受到的负面影响主要通过财务困境传导，而非心理健康或劳动力供给的变化。粗略估算显示，九个州的体育博彩合法化每年导致新增28.4万个食品不足家庭，并产生1.302亿美元的额外医疗支出。

title: US Monetary Policy, Exchange Rates, and Delayed Portfolio Adjustments
title_zh: 美国货币政策、汇率与延迟的投资组合调整
title_primary: 美国货币政策、汇率与延迟的投资组合调整
title_secondary: US Monetary Policy, Exchange Rates, and Delayed Portfolio Adjustments
authors: Sangyup Choi, Jongho Park, Kwangyong Park
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: What accounts for cross-country heterogeneity in exchange-rate responses to U.S. monetary policy shocks? Using daily data around Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements for 34 countries from 2001 to 2019, we show that countries with deeper financial markets experience larger currency depreciations following contractionary U.S. monetary policy shocks. This amplification is concentrated in forward-guidance shocks rather than contemporaneous target-rate surprises. The result is robust to alternative measures of financial market depth and to controls for domestic monetary policy responses, broad dollar movements, and various country characteristics. The amplification fades within approximately one month, suggesting that financial market depth matters primarily for high-frequency exchange-rate adjustment. A parsimonious portfolio-adjustment model interprets these empirical patterns by linking market depth to lower rebalancing costs and by treating forward guidance as news about future interest-rate differentials.
abstract_zh: 什么因素导致了各国汇率对美国货币政策冲击的异质性反应？利用2001年至2019年34个国家在联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后的日度数据，我们发现，金融市场深度较大的国家在遭遇紧缩性美国货币政策冲击时，会经历更大幅度的货币贬值。这种放大效应集中于前瞻性指引冲击，而非同期目标利率意外变化。该结果在采用替代性金融市场深度指标、控制国内货币政策反应、广义美元走势以及多种国家特征后依然稳健。放大效应约在一个月内消退，表明金融市场深度主要影响高频汇率调整。一个简约的投资组合调整模型通过将市场深度与较低的投资组合再平衡成本相联系，并将前瞻性指引视为关于未来利差的信息，对这些实证模式进行了解释。

title: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
title_zh: 临时性增值税减免作为非常规财政政策
title_primary: 临时性增值税减免作为非常规财政政策
title_secondary: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
authors: Rüdiger Bachmann, Benjamin Born, Olga Goldfayn-Frank, Georgi Kocharkov, Ralph Luetticke 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We exploit Germany’s temporary three-percentage-point VAT cut in the second half of 2020 to study the spending response to unconventional fiscal policy. We use survey and scanner data on household consumption expenditures and their perceived pass-through of the tax change into prices, and a HANK model to quantify the effects of this VAT policy. The survey and scanner data show that the temporary VAT reduction led to a relative increase in durable and, to a lesser extent, semi-durable spending for individuals with high perceived pass-through. According to the HANK model, the VAT policy increased total aggregate consumption spending by 4.4 percent on impact.
abstract_zh: 本文利用德国2020年下半年临时性下调增值税三个百分点的政策，研究非传统财政政策对消费支出的影响。我们采用家庭消费支出的调查与扫描数据，以及消费者对税改价格传导的感知程度，并借助HANK模型量化该增值税政策的效果。调查与扫描数据显示，对于感知传导程度较高的群体，临时性增值税下调显著提升了耐用品支出，半耐用品支出也有较小幅度的增长。根据HANK模型测算，该增值税政策在实施初期使总消费支出增加了4.4%。

title: Overbuying, Demand Withholding, and Single Sourcing Under Decreasing Returns
title_zh: 递减收益下的过度购买、需求抑制与单一采购
title_primary: 递减收益下的过度购买、需求抑制与单一采购
title_secondary: Overbuying, Demand Withholding, and Single Sourcing Under Decreasing Returns
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Consider suppliers whose comparative advantages, which are unknown to a buyer, depend on the quantity procured. The distortions of the buyer purchase policy differs depending on the market characteristics. In a large market, either it overbuys to suppliers with steep marginal costs, who are better at producing a small volume; or it withholds the demand it addresses to suppliers with flatter marginal costs, who are better at producing a large volume. The latter policy is implemented through a concave tariff offered to the less capacity constrained suppliers. In a small market, demand withholding prevails and some suppliers can be excluded.
abstract_zh: 考虑那些比较优势不为买方所知、且取决于采购数量的供应商。买方采购政策的扭曲程度因市场特征而异。在大市场中，要么对边际成本陡峭、擅长小批量生产的供应商过度采购；要么对边际成本平缓、擅长大批量生产的供应商缩减需求。后一种政策通过向产能约束较小的供应商提供凹形关税来实现。在小市场中，需求缩减占主导地位，部分供应商可能被排除在外。

title: Impact of gender equality on forest protection: Role of economic, social, political and energy factors
title_zh: 性别平等对森林保护的影响：经济、社会、政治与能源因素的作用
title_primary: 性别平等对森林保护的影响：经济、社会、政治与能源因素的作用
title_secondary: Impact of gender equality on forest protection: Role of economic, social, political and energy factors
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We empirically examined the impact of gender equality on forest protection using data for 151 countries from 2000 to 2023 via panel estimation. The results supported that gender equality usually associates with more forest protection, which is reliable while we conducted regression by changing estimations, employing measurements of forest protection and gender equality. In addition, this positive impact is weakened by industrial structure, income inequality, governmental spending, while it is stronger among OECD countries. Moreover, the positive impact of gender equality on forest protection is weaker among right-wing governments and countries with political corruption, while it is strengthened by governmental effectiveness, political stability and regulatory quality. Finally, growing disasters such as epidemics and wet mass movement would reduce gender equality’s positive impact on forest protection, while renewable energy consumption would benefit for it. Our conclusions offered several policy implications for governments to promote forest protection.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2000年至2023年间151个国家的面板数据，实证考察了性别平等对森林保护的影响。研究结果支持性别平等通常与更有效的森林保护相关联，这一结论在通过变换估计方法、采用不同的森林保护与性别平等衡量指标进行回归后依然稳健。此外，这种积极影响会受到产业结构、收入不平等及政府支出的削弱，而在OECD国家中则更为显著。进一步地，性别平等对森林保护的正面作用在右翼政府及政治腐败严重的国家中较弱，而政府效能、政治稳定性及监管质量的提升则会强化这一效应。最后，诸如流行病和湿物质运动等日益增多的灾害会减弱性别平等对森林保护的积极影响，而可再生能源消费则对此有所助益。我们的研究结论为政府促进森林保护提供了多项政策启示。

title: Fracking ghost towns: How neighborhood exposure drives population decline
title_zh: 压裂鬼城：社区暴露如何驱动人口下降
title_primary: 压裂鬼城：社区暴露如何驱动人口下降
title_secondary: Fracking ghost towns: How neighborhood exposure drives population decline
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The fracking revolution has exposed more than 15 million American residents to drilling within 3 miles, a tripling from conventional extraction methods. While the economic benefits are distributed across nearby counties, the environmental and neighborhood costs are concentrated within miles of a well. Using granular data on exposure and outcomes, I show that nearby fracking activity shrinks neighborhood population by 5%. The spatial decay, temporal pattern, and mechanisms of this treatment effect operate to debunk the stylized argument that fracking creates local boom towns.
abstract_zh: 水力压裂革命已使超过1500万美国居民暴露于3英里范围内的钻井活动，这一数字是传统开采方法的三倍。尽管经济效益分布于邻近各县，环境和社区成本却集中在油井数英里之内。利用关于暴露程度和结果的精细数据，我表明附近的压裂活动使社区人口缩减了5%。这一处理效应的空间衰减、时间模式及其作用机制，共同驳斥了压裂创造地方繁荣城镇的典型论点。

title: Ground‐Level Ozone and Agricultural Productivity in China
title_zh: 中国地面臭氧与农业生产力
title_primary: 中国地面臭氧与农业生产力
title_secondary: Ground‐Level Ozone and Agricultural Productivity in China
authors: Xiaoli Wang, Qian Li, Jing Gao, Xiaoguang Chen
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a county‐level dataset covering agricultural total factor productivity (TFP), crop yields, weather and ground‐level air pollution from 2003 to 2015, this study investigates the effects of air pollution, specifically ozone (O 3 ), on agricultural TFP. We find that O 3 pollution is strongly associated with productivity losses, with each one‐standard‐deviation increase in O 3 linked to a 33% reduction in TFP, far exceeding the negative impacts of other pollutants and temperature extremes. These adverse effects are primarily driven by declines in labour productivity, land productivity and crop yields and are further exacerbated by extreme temperatures. Between 2003 and 2015, agricultural TFP losses due to rising O 3 pollution grew from 9.8% to 46.6%. As an adaptive response, farmers adjust production practices, particularly by increasing fertiliser use, to mitigate productivity losses. Our findings highlight the urgent need for integrated policies that address both air pollution and climate extremes to promote agricultural sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2003年至2015年涵盖农业全要素生产率（TFP）、作物产量、天气及地面空气污染的县级数据集，考察了空气污染（特别是臭氧O₃）对农业TFP的影响。研究发现，O₃污染与生产率损失密切相关，O₃每增加一个标准差，TFP下降33%，远超其他污染物及极端温度带来的负面影响。这些不利影响主要由劳动生产率、土地生产率和作物产量的下降驱动，并因极端温度而进一步加剧。2003年至2015年间，因O₃污染上升导致的农业TFP损失从9.8%增至46.6%。作为适应性应对措施，农民调整生产实践，尤其是增加化肥使用，以缓解生产率损失。研究结果凸显了亟需制定统筹应对空气污染与气候极端事件的综合政策，以促进农业可持续发展。

title: Decoding news: How media risk and ambiguity shape CDS spreads
title_zh: 解读新闻：媒体风险与模糊性如何影响信用违约互换利差
title_primary: 解读新闻：媒体风险与模糊性如何影响信用违约互换利差
title_secondary: Decoding news: How media risk and ambiguity shape CDS spreads
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We introduce a novel method to quantify perceived global risk and ambiguity in media attention using content analysis. First, we apply structural topic modeling to risk-related news articles to identify distinct sources of uncertainty. We define ambiguity in attention as the variability in the distribution of topic probabilities across articles—that is, the extent to which media coverage diverges in its focus on different topics. In contrast, perceived risk is measured as the share of articles that assign a particular topic as their primary focus. We then examine whether these measures of perceived global risk and ambiguity in attention can explain changes in credit default swap (CDS) spreads. Our results show that greater ambiguity in news media attention is associated with a decrease in CDS spreads by up to 5.9%, while higher perceived risk corresponds to an increase of up to 4.9%. These findings highlight the role of media-driven uncertainty in shaping investor behavior and market risk perceptions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法，通过内容分析来量化媒体关注中的感知全球风险与模糊性。首先，我们将结构主题模型应用于风险相关新闻文章，以识别不确定性的不同来源。我们将注意力中的模糊性定义为文章间主题概率分布的变异性——即媒体覆盖在不同主题上的关注分散程度。相比之下，感知风险则通过将特定主题作为主要焦点的文章占比来衡量。随后，我们考察了这些感知全球风险与注意力模糊性的度量是否能解释信用违约互换（CDS）利差的变化。结果显示，新闻媒体注意力中更高的模糊性与CDS利差下降高达5.9%相关联，而更高的感知风险则对应利差上升高达4.9%。这些发现凸显了媒体驱动的确定性在塑造投资者行为和市场风险感知中的作用。

title: Cooperative games with unpaid players
title_zh: 无报酬参与者的合作博弈
title_primary: 无报酬参与者的合作博弈
title_secondary: Cooperative games with unpaid players
authors: Sylvain Béal, Léa Munich, Philippe Solal, Kevin Techer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider cooperative TU-games with unpaid players, which are described by a TU-game and two categories of players, paid and unpaid. Unpaid players participate in the cooperative game but are not rewarded for their participation, for instance for legal reasons. The objective is then to determine how the contributions of unpaid players are redistributed among the paid players. To meet this goal, we introduce and characterize axiomatically three values that are inspired by the Shapley value but differ in the way they redistribute the contributions of unpaid players. These values are unified as instances of a more general two-step allocation procedure.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑具有未支付参与者的合作TU博弈，此类博弈由TU博弈及两类参与者（支付与未支付）描述。未支付参与者参与合作博弈，但因其参与而不获报酬，例如出于法律原因。目标在于确定未支付参与者的贡献如何在支付参与者之间重新分配。为实现此目标，我们引入并公理化刻画了三种值，它们受Shapley值启发，但在重新分配未支付参与者贡献的方式上有所不同。这些值统一为更一般的两步分配程序的实例。

title: A limit to envy in large matching markets with incomplete information
title_zh: 不完全信息下大型匹配市场中嫉妒的极限
title_primary: 不完全信息下大型匹配市场中嫉妒的极限
title_secondary: A limit to envy in large matching markets with incomplete information
official: 官方在线 2025-05-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study matching markets in which each man has a common value for all women and a private value specific to each woman. We introduce a new class of procedures, which is a novel way of studying the deferred acceptance mechanism. These procedures can be replicated by another procedure, in which a woman proposes to a random man in each step. Envy in a matching market is bounded by envy in this class of procedures, in which there is just one woman and two types of men. In large markets, envy goes to zero; moreover, the deferred acceptance mechanism is approximately strategy-proof.
abstract_zh: 我们研究匹配市场，其中每位男性对所有女性有一个共同价值，并对每位女性有一个特定私人价值。我们引入了一类新的程序，这是研究延迟接受机制的一种新颖方式。这些程序可以通过另一种程序复制，在该程序中，女性在每一步向随机男性提出建议。匹配市场中的嫉妒程度受限于这类程序中仅有一位女性和两类男性的嫉妒程度。在大市场中，嫉妒趋于零；此外，延迟接受机制近似于策略证明性。
